args.title: checkout-api: v2.3.1 failing health checks — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions after the latest deploy, with an error rate of 18%. The service was rolled back in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Post-rollback health checks verified the service is healthy with an error rate of 0.2%. v2.3.1 should be investigated and fixed before redeploying.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions taken:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back** all production regions to **v2.3.0** — the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.3.1-rc was only deployed to staging, so it didn't qualify).
3. **Verified** the rollback: checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.0 across all three regions with an error rate of 0.2%.
4. **Opened incident INC-0001** (SEV2) describing the failure and the rollback, which has paged the on-call engineer.

v2.3.1 should be investigated and fixed before it's redeployed — note that a future re-deploy of a fixed version would fall under the change-manager approval policy if it has never been healthy in production.
